svg.title: Muthukumaran Muthiah · Technical Lead
svg.desc: Muthukumaran Muthiah — Technical Lead and full-stack developer in Chennai, India. Junior Technical Lead at RAVSoft Solutions with 7.5+ years of experience in EdTech and clinical trial systems, focused on microservices, event sourcing, CQRS, DDD and TDD. Stack: PHP, Laravel, Node.js, Vue.js, Angular, React, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, HELM and AWS. Shown beside an ASCII-art portrait.
